# Phase Sequences

<!-- Generated by generate-swiftui-skill.py; edit the library sources. -->

Category: Motion

Replay a short emphasis sequence while it is still running to compare overlapping delayed mutations with a sequence driven by a single phase animator.

- Before: Delayed updates overlap
- After: Phases run in sequence

APIs: `phaseAnimator`, `Task`

## Complete improved example

Adapt the behavior to the app; demonstration controls and values are illustrative.

```swift
import SwiftUI

// iOS 17+. Present SequenceDoExample() in your app.
struct SequenceDoExample: View {
    @State private var phase = 0
    @State private var resetID = 0

    var body: some View {
        VStack(spacing: 20) {
            SequenceDoContent(phase: phase)
                .frame(maxWidth: 320, minHeight: 180)
                .id(resetID)
            Button("Run example") { phase += 1 }

            Button("Reset") { phase = 0; resetID += 1 }
        }
        .padding()
    }
}

struct SequenceDoContent: View {
    var font: Font = .largeTitle
    let phase: Int
    @Environment(\.accessibilityReduceMotion) private var reduceMotion

    var body: some View {
        // excerpt:start
        Image(systemName: "checkmark.circle.fill")
            .font(font)
            .phaseAnimator([0, 1, 2], trigger: phase) { content, step in
                content.scaleEffect(reduceMotion ? 1 : (step == 1 ? 1.35 : 1))
            } animation: { _ in
                reduceMotion ? nil : .easeInOut(duration: 0.35)
            }
            .accessibilityLabel("Saved")
        // excerpt:end
    }

}
```
